title: Berry Protein Smoothie
description: Blended Greek yogurt, berries, protein powder and almond milk for a drinkable, protein-rich snack.
steps: Add the almond milk and frozen berries to a blender.
Add the yogurt and protein powder, then blend until smooth.
Sprinkle flaxseed on top before drinking.
notes: Frozen berries add thickness without diluting the protein — a roughly 1:1 carb-to-protein ratio works well right after training.
